chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Ja'far, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ubaydullah al-Dahqan, from Durusta al-Wasiti, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'When you eat cucumbers, eat them from their lower part, for it is greater in its blessing.'
ai.seo_question: Why should cucumbers be eaten from the bottom according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) advises consuming cucumbers from their lower part to maximize their *barakah*, reflecting the Shia tradition of finding spiritual potency in mundane acts. This specific instruction underscores the belief that physical mannerisms, when aligned with prophetic guidance, serve as vessels for divine favor and health. It illustrates the holistic Shia worldview where the material and spiritual realms intersect through daily practices.
